scope: Local bounded controls; no formal case-comparison result and no production-code changes.

invalid_anchor.recipe: FV-evaluate the anchor, replace every limit_c by peak-0.5; run fixed_aspect with BISECTION_STEPS patched to 0, budget 100 and this anchor; run anchored with budget 100, workers 1 and resolution 16.

zero_budget.recipe: Restore every limit_c to the measured anchor peak; anchored with fv_budget 0, inner blind, workers 1 and resolution 16.

failure_injection.note: Mocked solver timeout to test control flow; no claim of a natural timeout on this small input. The start is geometry- and wire-feasible; this control does not certify its thermal feasibility under the deliberately lowered limit.
failure_injection.fixed_carrier_recipe: Patch milp_relations to return None and MILP_STATUS.status to time_limit; call fixed_carrier on the original carrier with the anchor, no proxy, milp_s 1, threads 1 and directions None.
failure_injection.family_recipe: Patch fixed_carrier to return (None, [time_limit]); family with original problem/anchor, aspect 1, area bounds 159/1500 mm2, steps 5, budget 100, milp_s 1, threads 1, directions None, resolution 16, chain_steps 3, default CostParams.
